expected:
Assert.Single(assembly.Migrations,
            entry => entry.Key.EndsWith("_MeetingSessionsForPublication", StringComparison.Ordinal))

            ["created_at", "id", "meeting_id", "planned_ends_at", "planned_starts_at", "status", "title", "updated_at"],
            table.Columns.Select(column => column.Name).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal))

Assert.Equal(ReferentialAction.Cascade, foreignKey.OnDelete)
Assert.Single(migration.UpOperations.OfType<CreateIndexOperation>())
Assert.Equal("meeting_sessions", index.Table)
Assert.Equal(["meeting_id", "status"], index.Columns)
Assert.False(index.IsUnique)
Assert.Equal("meeting_sessions", Assert.IsType<DropTableOperation>(Assert.Single(migration.DownOperations)).Name)

3. Reload.
expected: Exactly one account persists with correct fields and role.

title: Reject duplicate email and preserve input
precondition: AdminUsers; existing email.
steps:
1. Submit an existing email.
2. Inspect error.
3. Correct email and resubmit.
expected: Duplicate is rejected; form input remains editable; correction creates one account.

title: Deactivate a signed-in user
precondition: Separate admin/user browsers; target is not final administrator.
steps:
1. Deactivate target.
2. Reload protected data as target.
3. Try signing in again.
expected: Inactive user cannot read protected data or sign in; list reflects backend state.

title: Manage a custom role
precondition: AdminUsers; unassigned disposable role; another active admin remains.
steps:
1. Create and rename role.
2. Toggle MeetingCreator, save and reload.
3. Delete role.
expected: Changes persist; role is removed; system-role protections remain effective.

title: Protect the last active administrator
precondition: Isolated environment with exactly one active AdminUsers user.
steps:
1. Try deactivating user.
2. Try removing final administrative capability through roles.
expected: Operations are rejected and an active administrator remains.

title: Hide restricted administration screens
precondition: Active user without AdminUsers; known management URLs.
steps:
1. Inspect sidebar.
2. Open management URL directly.
3. Call a fixed management API.
expected: Sidebar hides restricted entry; UI shows 404; fixed API returns 403 without protected data.

title: Create and edit a draft meeting
precondition: MeetingCreator; future meeting time.
steps:
1. Create a valid Draft.
2. Edit title, schedule and location.
3. Reload details.
expected: Draft persists with latest valid values.

title: Validate meeting information
precondition: MeetingCreator account.
steps:
1. Submit missing required fields.
2. Set end before start.
3. Correct and submit.
expected: Invalid input is rejected; a valid submission creates one meeting.

title: Search, filter and protect meeting list
precondition: Visible meetings in several states; an unreadable meeting.
steps:
1. Search title.
2. Apply filters and paging.
3. Open visible details.
4. Try unreadable URL.
expected: Results match filters; restricted records are absent and direct access returns 404.

title: Submit and approve meeting
precondition: Ready Draft; organizer and assigned active approver in separate browsers.
steps:
1. Select approver and submit.
2. Approve as assigned approver.
3. Reload history.
expected: Draft becomes WaitingApproval then Approved; history records correct actor/action.

title: Reject, revise and resubmit
precondition: WaitingApproval meeting; authorized organizer and approver.
steps:
1. Reject with reason.
2. Read reason and revise.
3. Resubmit.
expected: Reason is visible; Rejected permits revision; previous history remains intact.

title: Require meeting roles before publication
precondition: Approved A has active Chair and Secretary; B lacks Secretary. Seed rosters because roster UI is unavailable.
steps:
1. Publish A.
2. Try publishing B.
3. Reload both.
expected: A becomes Published; B remains Approved with validation error; no participant is silently added.

title: Reschedule a published meeting
precondition: Published fixture; organizer/participants; SMTP sandbox.
steps:
1. Change permitted time/location.
2. Save and reload.
3. Check participant notifications.
expected: Permitted changes persist, locked fields stay unchanged, intended recipients receive updates.

title: Switch calendar views and open details
precondition: Readable meetings across weeks/months, including near midnight.
steps:
1. Switch week/month/list.
2. Navigate dates.
3. Open preview and details.
expected: Times agree in browser time zone; correct meeting opens; unreadable meetings remain hidden.

title: Receive notification and persist read status
precondition: Two users; event for one recipient; active hub.
steps:
1. Observe bell after event.
2. Mark one read.
3. Mark all read.
4. Reload.
expected: Only intended user receives event; unread count and persisted read state are correct.

title: Follow notification after access revocation
precondition: Old notification targets a now-unreadable meeting.
steps:
1. Open bell.
2. Follow old notification.
3. Inspect target response/page.
expected: Inaccessible target is handled without exposing restricted meeting content.

title: Provision access, create a meeting and revoke permission
precondition: AdminUsers; MeetingCreator role; new user; staging PostgreSQL/Redis.
steps:
1. Create user and assign role.
2. Sign in as user.
3. Create Draft.
4. Remove creation capability.
5. Reload and retry creation.
expected: Creation succeeds while authorized and fails after revocation; original Draft remains intact.

title: Draft, submission, rejection, revision and approval
precondition: Separate active organizer/approver; ready meeting; notification worker.
steps:
1. Create and submit Draft.
2. Read notification and reject with reason.
3. Revise and resubmit.
4. Approve.
5. Inspect history.
expected: Transitions/recipients are correct; reasons and history persist; unauthorized actions fail.

title: Publication, notifications, email and Calendar
precondition: Approved fixture with active Chair/Secretary and participants; seeded roster; SMTP sandbox; workers enabled.
steps:
1. Publish.
2. Receive notification and ICS email.
3. Follow notification.
4. Compare Calendar and details.
expected: Published status and schedule agree; intended recipients receive invitation; retries do not duplicate; outsiders receive no data.

title: Synchronize published meeting reschedule
precondition: Published meeting; participants; original invitation recorded; SMTP sandbox.
steps:
1. Reschedule.
2. Inspect history.
3. Check bell, update email and Calendar.
4. Reload both browsers.
expected: All screens show latest schedule; history records change; updates contain new time.

title: Deactivate, revoke sessions and restore access
precondition: Independent admin; target signed in on two tabs; not final admin.
steps:
1. Deactivate target.
2. Try reading/editing from both tabs.
3. Reactivate.
4. Sign in again.
expected: Operations fail while inactive; new sign-in succeeds after reactivation; old sessions cannot bypass active-user checks.

title: Reset password across email and authentication
precondition: Administrator/test user; SMTP sandbox; issued reset link.
steps:
1. Request reset.
2. Complete through email.
3. Try old/new passwords.
4. Reuse token.
5. Check old sessions against auth contract.
expected: Old password fails; new one works; token is single-use; session revocation follows backend contract.

title: Isolate meeting data across roles
precondition: Organizer, assigned approver, participant, outsider; Draft/WaitingApproval/Published fixtures.
steps:
1. Open list/details as each role.
2. Try history, edit and transitions.
3. Replace approver and retry as former approver.
expected: Access follows relationship/state; unrelated or revoked users cannot read restricted data; inaccessible records return 404.

title: Recover queued email after SMTP outage
precondition: Isolated staging; controllable SMTP sandbox; valid Approved fixture.
steps:
1. Stop SMTP.
2. Publish.
3. Inspect retry state.
4. Restart SMTP and allow retry.
5. Compare mail and queue.
expected: Publication persists; email retries after recovery without duplicate deduplication keys.

title: Operate agenda through complete meeting UI
precondition: Blocked: agenda UI and meeting-start workflow unavailable in this checkout.
steps:
1. Create/reorder agenda in UI.
2. Start meeting.
3. Start/finish item as Chair.
4. Observe participant browser.
expected: After integration, order/state/duration synchronize according to API; re-execute workflow.

title: Administer user access
precondition: Administrator representative; disposable accounts.
steps:
1. Create user and role.
2. Assign capabilities.
3. Deactivate/reactivate.
4. Confirm permitted work.
expected: Tasks are usable; permissions correct; final administrator protected.

title: Prepare a meeting
precondition: Organizer with MeetingCreator.
steps:
1. Create Draft with schedule/location/content.
2. Edit.
3. Find and reopen.
expected: Information persists; organizer confirms form supports preparation.

title: Review meeting requests
precondition: Organizer/approver representatives; ready meetings.
steps:
1. Submit.
2. Approve one meeting.
3. Reject another with reason.
4. Check feedback.
expected: Parties understand outcomes/reasons; history identifies reviewer.

title: Receive correct invitation
precondition: Approved fixture with roster; participant; SMTP sandbox.
steps:
1. Publish.
2. Read notification and ICS email.
3. Open details and Calendar.

title: Understand schedule change
precondition: Published meeting; organizer and participant.
steps:
1. Reschedule.
2. Find new time through notification and Calendar.
3. Confirm applicable time.
expected: Participant recognizes latest time without contradictory information.

title: Protect meeting information
precondition: Participant and unrelated-user representatives.
steps:
1. Open invited meeting.
2. Search/enter URL as outsider.
3. Review with administrator.
expected: Participant sees permitted data; outsider cannot view restricted content.

title: Reset forgotten password
precondition: Administrator/user representatives; SMTP sandbox.
steps:
1. Request reset.
2. Read email and change password.
3. Sign in again.
expected: User can follow instructions; consumed link cannot be reused.

title: Use supported browsers
precondition: Chrome/Edge; record versions and screen sizes in evidence.
steps:
1. Sign in.
2. Find meeting.
3. Open Calendar.
4. Read notifications.
5. Record suggestions.
expected: No UI defect blocks tasks; feedback is recorded separately from acceptance.
